args.sql:
SELECT 
    t2.containregistry AS container_id,
    COUNT(t1.tempdevcount) AS temperature_deviations,
    ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT t1.alertkind) AS alert_types
FROM 
    sensordata AS t1
JOIN 
    container AS t2 ON t1.containlink = t2.containregistry
GROUP BY 
    t2.containregistry
ORDER BY 
    temperature_deviations DESC
LIMIT 5;
